name: tally-web-app
description: Full-stack accounting web application for Tally Prime 2.1 — modern HTML/CSS/JS frontend, Node.js (Express) middleware, Tally XML API + ODBC integration with real-time bi-directional sync.
author: Tally Web App

notes.odbc: The 'odbc' npm package is a NATIVE module (requires windows-build-tools / ODBC SDK headers). It is intentionally NOT auto-installed. On the machine that talks to Tally via ODBC run: npm run setup:odbc  — the backend lazy-loads it and degrades gracefully when absent.
